title: The ritual stance affects perceptions of effort
core_idea: Tests whether framing identical activities as ritual versus ordinary changes how people perceive their difficulty and experienced affect, assessing the proposal that a distinct 'ritual stance' prioritizes symbolic and social value over utilitarian demands and thus alters cost–benefit appraisals.
tldr: The study investigates whether presenting the same actions in ritual versus ordinary contexts shifts perceived difficulty and happiness, empirically probing the hypothesis that a ritual stance functions as a cognitive lens that reinterprets costs in symbolic/social terms.
